verdict.rationale: Docs claim autonomous agents that 'read files, manage calendars, and take actions via WhatsApp, Discord, or Slack' and that Jan can be given a task and 'works on it autonomously' (jan-docs-13, jan-docs-14), supported by MCP integration for agentic capabilities (jan-gh-5/14). However, the same docs state each tool call must be individually approved via inline approval panels (jan-docs-9), which undercuts true unattended background automation, and there's no evidence of scheduling/trigger-based automation setup. Missing for 10: documented scheduling/trigger mechanism, evidence of fully unattended (no-approval) background runs, independent confirmation of long-running autonomous sessions.
